data.long_meaning: The name Geibel is derived from the Old German words 'geib' meaning 'god' and 'bel' meaning 'shining one'. This name is believed to have been given to those who were believed to be favored by the gods or who had exceptional battle skills. The name Geibel carries the meaning “Battle elf” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Geibel usually hope their child will grow to embody battle elf and live with faith, good character and purpose.
